children: New Delhi, Oct. 10 -- Avenue Supermarts posted its earnings for the quarter ended OCtober 2026 (Q2FY27) on Saturday, October 10.

Consolidated Net profit jumped 8.5% to Rs.742.98 crore from Rs.685.01 crore in the year-ago period. Meanwhile, total income rose almost 18% to Rs.19,657.50 crore versus Rs.16,695.87 crore in the same period last year.
